biological_interpretation: Basal CREB1 perturbation triggers paralogous CREM compensation rather than an acute pCREB-like activity transcriptome.
caveats: The parquet reports gene-level Crem expression and cannot distinguish activating CREM isoforms from ICER repressor isoforms; no direct Crem or Atf1 perturbation was available for reciprocity.
The dataset measures guide-assigned basal transcriptomes, not synchronized neuronal depolarization or cAMP pulses; weak or transient immediate-early responses could be missed.

Exact log2 fold changes, scores, p-values, and FDRs in exact_de_rows were re-read from the Wilcoxon Parquet; the graph and cluster summaries were used only to nominate the target/readout combinations.
exact_observed_result: Creb1 perturbation induced a CREB-family state in thalamic, hypothalamic, and midbrain neurons dominated by recurrent Crem up-regulation, while upstream Prkaca, Adcy3, NMDA-receptor, and CaMKII perturbations did not recreate the signature and classic Arc/Bdnf/Fos/Egr/Npas4 immediate-early targets were not significantly induced. Parquet-verified leading rows: Creb1->Crem in 155 MB Glut log2FC 1.52, FDR 6.42e-10; Creb1->Crem in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut log2FC 1.09, FDR 3.82e-07; Creb1->Tmem181a in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut log2FC -0.915, FDR 3.55e-04; Creb1->Crem in 110 CNU-HYa HY MM Glut log2FC 1.38, FDR 0.00619; Creb1->Txndc12 in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut log2FC -1.07, FDR 0.00742; Creb1->Chkb in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut log2FC -0.636, FDR 0.00869.

prior_expectation.summary: References were retained only when they were linked to one of the resolved source findings.

finding_summaries.summary: Creb1 perturbation recurrently induces the CREB-family gene Crem, with Crem becoming the top positive gene in five responsive neuronal classes.
finding_summaries.why_it_matters: A paralog-family feedback signal is the dominant dataset-grounded output of Creb1 perturbation and matches the known ability of CREM to compensate for CREB loss, while raising the possibility that the measured Crem reads include repressive ICER isoforms.

finding_summaries.summary: Classic activity-dependent CREB targets are not significant in the Creb1 perturbation signatures.
finding_summaries.why_it_matters: The absence of Arc, Bdnf, Fos/Jun, Egr, Npas4, Nr4a1, Per1, and Vgf responses separates this perturbation state from the canonical stimulated pCREB immediate-early program.

resolved_evidence.description: Recurrent, FDR-significant induction of the Creb1 paralog-family gene Crem after Creb1 perturbation.
resolved_evidence.statistics: Crem was the rank-1 positive gene by score in 5 Creb1-perturbed classes: 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA logFC 1.328 score 4.760 FDR 0.0332; 110 CNU-HYa HY MM Glut logFC 1.381 score 5.089 FDR 0.00619; 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut logFC 1.092 score 6.691 FDR 3.82e-7; 155 MB Glut logFC 1.521 score 7.572 FDR 6.42e-10; 191 MB P MY GABA logFC 1.568 score 5.923 FDR 5.40e-5.

resolved_evidence.description: The thalamic Prkcd/Grin2c glutamatergic class had the largest FDR-significant Creb1 perturbation program.
resolved_evidence.statistics: 126 perturbed cells versus 23679 controls; 10 genes at FDR<0.05. Up: Crem logFC 1.092 FDR 3.82e-7, Creb1 logFC 0.705 FDR 0.0136, Vwc2l logFC 0.730 FDR 0.0490. Down: Tmem181a logFC -0.915 FDR 3.55e-4, Txndc12 -1.069 FDR 0.00742, Chkb -0.636 FDR 0.00869, Nceh1 -0.405 FDR 0.0139, Ppox -0.745 FDR 0.0301, Rnf139 -0.797 FDR 0.0490, Sez6l2 -0.320 FDR 0.0490.

resolved_evidence.description: Three responsive classes showed a sparse, Crem-dominated signature rather than a broad downstream program.
resolved_evidence.statistics: Creb1 perturbation produced exactly one FDR<0.05 gene, Crem, in 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA with 48 cells, 110 CNU-HYa HY MM Glut with 47 cells, and 191 MB P MY GABA with 55 cells; Crem logFC/FDR were 1.328/0.0332, 1.381/0.00619, and 1.568/5.40e-5, respectively.

resolved_evidence.description: Classic inducible neuronal CREB targets were not significant outputs of the basal Creb1 perturbation signatures.
resolved_evidence.statistics: Across 14 canonical activity/CREB-responsive genes tested in 21 Creb1-perturbed cell types each, 0/294 rows reached FDR<0.05; the largest absolute scores were Nr4a1 2.630 with min FDR 1.0, Arc 2.194 with min FDR 1.0, Fos 2.111 with min FDR 1.0, and Bdnf 1.278 with min FDR 1.0.

title: Creb1 perturbation selectively induces Crem compensation outside the upstream cAMP/NMDAR/CaMKII axis
